notes: Post-refactor regression pass covering RainVision.tsx -> hooks/useRainVision.ts + rainvision/*View.tsx split and HistoricalReplay -> hooks/useReplayPlayer.ts + components/historical/ReplayCards.tsx split. Removed one stale check (local-registration-and-alert-honesty) whose testids (sms-payload-ready, 'NOT CONFIGURED' text) no longer exist post-refactor; replaced with sms-gateway-honesty which asserts the current contract (SENDER_NOT_PROVISIONED -> FAILED/572002, masked phone, never SENT/DELIVERED). Added dashboard-nav-switches-views (all 10 nav testids/headings) and historical-replay-flow (full run/pause/step/resume/complete/reset cycle + network isolation) which were previously uncovered. Added backend tests for /api/historical/incidents (+404) and /api/sms/config contract, previously uncovered.
